##### Project general facts

Ayami Residence by AYAT Development is a residential building inspired by the idea of everyday comfort, its name drawn from the Arabic word for my days. A contemporary, restrained aesthetic with clean lines, panoramic glazing and elegant balconies gives the building a light and balanced appearance. It rises above a ground floor and a podium to six residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments with practical layouts and welcoming interiors.

Shared amenities bring together wellness, leisure and community. Residents enjoy a family pool and a children's pool alongside a rooftop swimming pool, fitness zones serving the entire building and a serene yoga room. A padel court, a podcast studio, an outdoor cinema, a barbecue lounge and children's play areas add variety, while landscaped communal spaces create welcoming places for relaxed evenings and social gatherings with neighbours, family and friends.

Interiors follow a warm, modern aesthetic with natural wood tones and soft neutral palettes that create an inviting atmosphere in every room. Large windows and bright finishes fill each home with natural light, while kitchens feature sleek cabinetry, stone countertops and quality fixtures, and bathrooms showcase stylish tiling. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Warsan First is an established residential district in eastern Dubai, set beside International City and close to Dubai Silicon Oasis and Dubai Academic City. The area combines mid-rise apartment buildings with Dragon Mart, community retail, cafes, clinics and schools, and its calm, practical streets appeal to young professionals, students and families seeking accessible city living.

Ras Al Khor Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Awir Road connect residents with the wider city, and the International City metro station is close by. Dragon Mart and City Centre Mirdif are a short drive away, Dubai Festival City and Dubai Creek Harbour are nearby, and Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Warsan First is a freehold area open to international buyers and one of the more accessible entry points to the Dubai property market. Studios and one-bedroom homes with extensive shared amenities attract tenants seeking value close to major employment hubs. Competitive prices, strong rental demand and improving infrastructure in eastern Dubai underpin attractive yields and long-term value for investors.
